title: Section A1 - Read & Say Aloud (Sentence)
instructions: In this section you will encounter 18 statements or audio clips. Read and record the statements or the content of the audio clips. You have a total of 10 minutes to complete all recordings, and every question is mandatory.

title: Section A2 - Read & Say Aloud (Paragraph)
instructions: Read the given paragraph carefully and then say the exact paragraph out loud. You have 30 seconds; your response submits automatically.

title: Section A3 - Listen & Say Aloud
instructions: Listen carefully to the audio recording and repeat the sentences exactly as you hear them. You have 15 seconds to record. You can only listen once and cannot pause the audio.

title: Section B - Speak on the Topic
instructions: In this section you will be given 3 topics on which you have to speak for 60 seconds each. You will have 90 seconds to think about each topic before recording starts automatically. Speaking points are shown as questions under the topic; they are suggestions only, and you may speak on other points related to the topic.

title: Section C1 - Verb Forms
instructions: In this section you will answer a total of 34 questions in five categories: verb forms (8), tenses (8), articles (6), prepositions (6) and voice change (6). You have 15 minutes to complete all the questions, and each question is mandatory. Fill in the blank using the correct form of the verb provided in brackets.

title: Section C2 - Tenses
instructions: Fill in the blank using the appropriate tense provided in brackets.

title: Section C3 - Articles
instructions: Fill in the blank using the correct article to complete the sentence appropriately.

title: Section C4 - Prepositions
instructions: Fill in the blank with the most suitable preposition provided in brackets.

title: Section C5 - Change the Voice (Active/Passive)
instructions: Change the voice of the following sentences (active/passive) as required, choosing the correct rewrite from the options.

title: Section D - Listen & Answer
instructions: In this section you will listen to audio clips followed by a set of questions. You have 10 minutes to finish all the questions. Pay close attention to the audio, as the next three questions will be based on it. You can only listen to the audio once and cannot pause it.

title: Section A1 - Read & Record (Sentence)
instructions: In this section you will be presented with 18 statements/audio clips. You will have to read and record the statements/content of the audio clips. Total time to complete the recordings is 10 min. All questions are mandatory.

title: Section A2 - Listen & Record
instructions: Listen to the audio clip once and record the sentence you heard. Maximum recording time 15 seconds.

title: Section B - Speak on the Topic
instructions: In this section you will be given 3 topics on which you need to speak for 1 minute each. For each topic you will get 30 seconds to think, after which your response will start getting recorded. If you prefer not to use the thinking time, you can skip and start recording your response. All questions are mandatory.

title: Section C1 - Verb Forms
instructions: In this section you are given 34 questions to be completed in 15 minutes. Read the sentence and fill in the blank using the correct form of the verb in brackets.

title: Section C2 - Tenses
instructions: Fill in the blank using the appropriate tense provided in brackets.

title: Section C3 - Articles
instructions: Fill in the blank using the correct article.

title: Section C4 - Prepositions
instructions: Fill in the blank with the most suitable preposition provided in brackets.

title: Section C5 - Change the Voice (Active/Passive)
instructions: Change the voice of the following sentences (active/passive) as required, choosing the correct rewrite from the options.

title: Section D - Listen & Answer
instructions: In this section you will be presented with audio clips and questions based on the audio clips. You are given 10 minutes to complete all the questions. You can play each clip once and cannot pause it; the next three questions are based on it. Type 'Okay' after each clip to proceed to its questions.
